data = scene_data()
print(type(data))
print(data.keys() if isinstance(data,dict) else '')
if isinstance(data,dict):
 print([(k,type(v).__name__) for k,v in data.items()])

witnesses = [('M16',[24.75,-1.625,3.75]),('M19',[22.5625,-1.625,3.75]),('M16',[24.75,-0.75,0.75]),('M14',[22.25,0.25,0.75])]
for name,point in witnesses:
 obj=next(o for o in data['objects'] if o['name']==name)
 vertices=np.asarray(obj['vertices'],dtype=float)
 point=np.asarray(point,dtype=float)
 hits=[]
 for triangle_index,indices in enumerate(obj['triangles']):
  triangle=vertices[np.asarray(indices,dtype=int)]
  edges=np.column_stack((triangle[1]-triangle[0],triangle[2]-triangle[0]))
  coefficients=np.linalg.lstsq(edges,point-triangle[0],rcond=None)[0]
  residual=np.linalg.norm(edges@coefficients-(point-triangle[0]))
  barycentric=np.array([1-coefficients.sum(),*coefficients])
  if residual<1e-10 and barycentric.min()>=-1e-10:
   hits.append({'source_triangle_index':triangle_index,'vertex_indices':indices,'barycentric':barycentric.tolist(),'residual_m':float(residual)})
 print(name,point.tolist(),hits)
